existing_features.title: Add Y-axis limit input controls (minimum and maximum) to the TSIC Loggers page that allow users to set custom lower and upper bounds for the graph's Y-axis. These controls should reset to automatic scaling on each page refresh.
Add checkboxes in the graph legend on the TSIC Loggers page that allow users to toggle individual sensors (S1-S72) on and off. All sensors should be enabled by default on each page refresh.

Add a download button to the TSIC Loggers page that links to the Google Spreadsheet at https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/11mSpPpRIZikPpacvWtXk-YIQD7ktIg4PHHtN_hIbKE8/edit?usp=sharing. Style the button to match the download button on the Conceptmachine page.
